name: SharePoint — move
description: Moves what it receives into a SharePoint folder of the team library: the input is the source, the folder argument the destination. Stores the input's files (in a subfolder named from document.meta when there is one), then runs source.release if the input has one (e.g. the email leaves the Outlook drop folder) — only once every file is stored, so on a failure the source stays where it was. Files are fetched at upload time from their from tool call, so tick that server too (e.g. Outlook). Exits ok {status, folder, files, web_urls, released} / no {status, reason}.
